remarks: Spacious and bright three-bedroom townhouse-style half duplex nestled in a quiet location, yet just minutes from all area amenities. The inviting living room features a bay window that fills the space with natural light, complemented by hardwood floors. The large eat-in kitchen offers ample space for dining and entertaining. Upstairs, you'll find three comfortable bedrooms and additional attic storage. Enjoy the convenience of in-home washer/dryer hookups and one off-street parking space. Prime location close to downtown Stamford, beaches, restaurants, shopping, entertainment, and recreational facilities. Easy access to Metro-North, I-95, and just under 40 miles to Manhattan-perfect for commuters! Agents, Please see remarks.
